title: Component CSS Property Manifest
description: Per-component record of visual CSS properties, the design token each one resolves from, the expected computed style value, and any per-variant overrides. Generated manifests serve as fixtures for Playwright computed-style assertions (see packages/ui/tests/visual).

component.description: Component identifier matching its src/components/ui/{component} directory and Storybook id (e.g. "button").

description.description: Optional human-readable note about what this manifest covers.

baseVariant.description: The variant axis values (e.g. { "variant": "solid", "color": "primary", "size": "md" }) that each property's top-level resolvedValue was captured against. Axis names must match the component's own prop names.

properties.description: One entry per visual CSS property tracked for this component.

variantAxes.description: A set of variant axis name/value pairs (e.g. variant, color, size, state) as accepted by the component's props.

property.description: CSS property name in camelCase as returned by window.getComputedStyle (e.g. backgroundColor, borderColor, fontSize).

token.description: Semantic design token key this property is sourced from (e.g. "brand-primary"), matching a key in packages/ui/src/theme/tokens/semantic.ts. Use null when the value is a literal not backed by a token.

cssVariable.description: CSS custom property backing the token (e.g. "--color-brand-primary"), as declared in packages/ui/src/theme/global.css. Omit or null when no CSS variable is involved.

resolvedValue.description: Expected computed style value for baseVariant, in the format getComputedStyle returns it (e.g. "rgb(255, 121, 0)", "8px").

variantOverrides.description: Overrides of token/resolvedValue for specific variant axis combinations, merged onto baseVariant.

variant.description: Partial variant axis values that trigger this override (e.g. { "variant": "outline" } or { "color": "error", "state": "hover" }).

token.description: Semantic token key for this override, or null for a literal value.

cssVariable.description: CSS custom property backing the token for this override.

resolvedValue.description: Expected computed style value when the variant axes match.
